## Key Insight
The disparate mass and energy scales of the Standard Model, from the cosmological constant to the Higgs VEV, are not independent parameters. They form a contiguous **Alpha Power Ladder** where each rung corresponds to a specific power of the fine structure constant $\alpha$ — **a pattern, not a proof**: see per-row tags below.
:::

## The Hierarchical Scale Formula

Every fundamental scale $\Lambda_n$ in FTD follows the general form:

$$\Lambda_n = m_P \cdot (2\pi)^{k/2} \cdot C \cdot \alpha^n$$ {#eq-alpha-ladder-general}

where:
- $m_P$ is the Planck mass.
- $(2\pi)^{k/2}$ is the geometric phase factor.
- $C$ is a framework coefficient (ratio of framework integers).
- $\alpha^n$ is the primary scale suppressor.

## The Integer Gaps

The gaps between the rungs of the ladder are not random; they encode the framework integers {3, 4, 7, 13}:

### 1. The Color Gap ($v \to m_e$)
The transition from the Higgs VEV ($n=8$) to the electron mass ($n=11$) has a gap of **+3**:
$$\Delta n = 11 - 8 = 3 = N_c$$
The number of color charges determines the mass suppression of the first-generation lepton.

### 2. The Base Gap ($v \to \rho_\Lambda$)
The transition from the Higgs scale to the vacuum energy suppression ($n=16$) has a gap of **+8**:
$$\Delta n = 16 - 8 = 8 = 2N_{\text{base}}$$
The lattice connectivity determines the vacuum energy suppression.

### 3. The Unified Gap ($m_e \to \alpha_G$)
The transition from the electron mass ($n=11$) to the gravitational coupling ($n=20$) has a gap of **+9**:
$$\Delta n = 20 - 11 = 9 = N_c^2$$
The square of the color charge number mediates the hierarchy between electromagnetism and gravity.

## Proton Mass Unification [SPECULATION] (flagged 2026-07-01)

The proton mass arises from the **Circular Mode** of the lattice action. While the electron follows the power ladder, the proton is anchored by the transcendental geometry of the circle:

$$m_p = m_e \cdot 6\pi^5 \approx 1836.12 \text{ m}_e$$ {#eq-proton-mass-unified}

**Derivation Link** (untagged "emerges" language corrected to `[SPECULATION]`): The factor $6\pi^5$ is presented here without a canonical LEDGER row backing it, and is a **different formula** from the corpus's canonical proton/electron ratio $m_p/m_e = N_{\text{eff}}/\alpha + N_{\text{base}}\cdot N_{\text{eff}} + N_c = 1836.47$ (174 ppm, `DERIV_BARYON_AND_QUARK_GEOMETRY.md`, itself [STRONGLY MOTIVATED CONJECTURE], not [DERIVED]). Two competing untagged/lightly-tagged formulas for the same ratio in the same corpus is itself a red flag; this remediation flags rather than silently resolves it — owner reconciliation needed.

## Significance of the Ladder

The Alpha Power Ladder reframes the Standard Model hierarchy problem (why is $m_e \ll v \ll m_P$?) as a **combinatorial pattern** across framework integers — a suggestive organizing observation, not a proof that the scales are forced. Per the per-row tags above, most rungs are `[PARAMETRIC]`/`[SPECULATION]`, not derivations; the pattern itself has not been shown to be the unique one framework integers could produce (no look-elsewhere/rigidity scan of this specific chain is on record, unlike the mass-formula rigidity audits elsewhere in the corpus).

::: {.callout-important}
## Conclusion (corrected 2026-07-01)
This is **not** "a single derivation chain." $\alpha$ itself is `x_+ = 1/\alpha`, a `[STRONGLY MOTIVATED CONJECTURE]` (FTD-0013), never `[DERIVED]` or fixed by the Master Quadratic alone (MC-T4.3 remains a `[FOUNDATIONAL OBSTRUCTION]`). Each rung above then carries its own independent, and generally weaker, epistemic status. The "discrete sequence of geometric couplings" is an observed pattern across several separately-motivated formulas, not a single forced chain — the prior framing overstated this by an order of magnitude.
:::
